blocks.body: This is the week check. You already met these errors. You are only proving you can name them. Fail the quiz and the next week stays locked. Retry as many times as you want.

items.title: A check, not a show
items.body:
This is the week boss: a clickable site, a PDF note, and a **required FAILED log**.

1. HTML you can click.
2. Tool name or missing-tool line.
3. FAILED first error + repair + SUCCESS.

Fail the quiz and **week 7 stays locked**. Retry as many times as you want. The 5-minute warmup does not open the week.

items.title: Word today
items.body: No new word. Use **publish**, **WebHelp**, **PDF**, **log**, **SUCCESS**, and **FAILED** in the two lines you paste.

blocks.title: Creating a Publishing Template to Customize WebHelp and PDF using CSS

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: No FAILED quote, or output lives in topics/, or you cannot name the PDF tool or skip reason, or the site never succeeded.

Expected: WebHelp SUCCESS path. PDF tool note. failed-first-error.txt complete. Completeness clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: On the week6-failed copy (or a fresh copy), start from a known-good booklet.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Run WebHelp to SUCCESS. Note the output folder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Run or record the PDF tool name (or missing-tool message).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Break one booklet path. Run WebHelp to FAILED. Quote the first real error. Repair. SUCCESS.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Confirm output is still outside source. Confirm the novice switch file in the site matches your explanation.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.body: Pass the quiz. Week 7 stays locked until this day is finished (lab + quiz + a short note).

blocks.summary: WebHelp SUCCESS path. PDF tool note. failed-first-error.txt complete. Completeness clean.

blocks.q: The first log line is INFO Loading plugins. Is that the quote for this check?
options: No :  quote the first real error that names the break
blocks.why: The badge is log reader, not log pasting.

blocks.q: A missing booklet target: completeness red, transform FAILED. Which do you run first next time?
options: Completeness on the booklet, then transform
blocks.why: Completeness is cheaper and names missing files before the engine starts.
